findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: estimate_steel_cost · Public sink: about_structomat, draft_project_request · Destructive: analyze_frame.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: estimate_steel_cost · Public sink: about_structomat, draft_project_request · Destructive: analyze_frame

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "analyze_frame" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Runs a 3D finite-element frame analysis and returns the numbers: equilibrium check, largest deflection along the members, largest joint displacement and sway in X and Y, every support reaction, the axial force, shears and moments of every member (the envelope with the governing combination when ther" → after: "Runs a 3D finite-element frame analysis and returns the numbers: equilibrium check, largest deflection along the members, largest joint displacement and sway in X and Y, every support reaction, the axial force, shears and moments of every member (the envelope with the governing combination when ther"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
